source.provenance: Independent direct E/B/J energy and cross-product flux,spatial/time five-point differences,actual radial volume and oriented cylindrical surface quadrature,finite-slab and whole-line SciPy integration; no product imports.
limitations: Independent references for prescribed source and transverse pulse teaching families.
Constant positive coefficients only;not dispersive/hysteretic/general matter energy.
Prescribed bounded induction source and infinite-transverse plane pulses are not finite isolated devices.
Whole-line pulse integral is energy per transverse area,not finite total3D energy.
Poynting balance alone does not verify every Maxwell equation.
Observed errors are not certified bounds.

cancellation.provenance: 180-digit mpmath references,normalized SciPy slab quadrature,and expm1 Gaussian difference; no product imports.
limitations: Analytic conditional velocity is not an observed ratio when absolute energy is unavailable.
Exact zero amplitude has zero energy and undefined conditional energy velocity.
A tiny Gaussian tail is not a compactly supported pulse.

physicalScale.provenance: Physical-scale SI coefficient example and180-digit exact-binary-input energy-component reference; no product imports.
physicalScale.lesson: A dominant magnetic rate can hide a nonzero electric/source-work defect in a naive total. Show component powers and stable grouping; analytic grouping still needs independent verification.
